t: How to Connect a Eleva Sub-Account with Zapier
html:
Connect your Eleva sub-account to Zapier (via the Eleva Zapier app) to automate lead capture, contact updates, and handoffs without code. This guide explains what the integration is, prerequisites, and how to connect/disconnect a sub-account.

Connecting a Sub-Account with Zapier


Zapier lets Eleva exchange data with thousands of apps. Using the Eleva Zapier app, you authenticate with your Eleva CRM login, then choose which sub-account to connect so Zaps can create/update contacts, move data, and trigger actions.

Key Benefits Connecting a Sub-Account with Zapier


These advantages help you decide when to connect Zapier for process automation.

  • Fast automation: Trigger actions across thousands of apps without custom code.

  • Sub-account scoped: Choose the specific sub-account to keep data clean and separated.

  • Simple auth: Use your Eleva CRM login—no API keys required for this connection.

  • Easy maintenance: Manage or disconnect the Eleva connection from Zapier’s App Connections page.

How To Connect a Sub-Account with Zapier


Follow these steps in Zapier to connect the right sub-account via Eleva.


  1. Log in to your Zapier account.

  2. On the home screen, click Create > Zaps.



  3. In the Zap editor, click on the Trigger block and select Eleva from the list of apps.



  4. Select a TriggerEvent like PipelineStageChanged.

  5. Under the Account section of the trigger setup, click on the Sign In button.

  6. You will be redirected to the Eleva login screen. Enter your email and password to proceed.



  7. After logging in, you’ll be prompted to select the sub-account you want to connect with Zapier.




  8. Once completed, your Zapier account will be successfully connected to the sub-account. You’ll see Eleva listed under “Accounts” in your Zap setup, confirming the integration is active.

How to Disconnect Eleva from Zapier


  1. On the Zapier home page, click on App Connections in the left-hand menu.

  2. Click the three-dot menu (•••) next to Eleva.

  3. Select Delete to remove the connection.

Frequently Asked Questions


Q: Is the Zapier app named “Eleva”?
In Zapier, use Eleva—it’s the official, whitelabeled Eleva connection. 


Q: Can I change the connected sub-account later?

Yes—add a new Eleva account connection in Zapier and select the other sub-account, then switch the account used in your Zaps.


Q: How do I fully disconnect?

In Zapier → Apps → App Connections, locate Eleva, open the ••• menu, and Delete the connection. 


Q: Do I need API keys for this?

Not for the standard Eleva connection flow; you sign in with your CRM credentials. 


Q: Why can't I see all my Eleva sub-accounts when connecting to Zapier?

The Eleva connection lets you select a Eleva sub-account during authorization. If an expected sub-account is missing, check that you're using the correct Eleva login and confirm your access to that sub-account. If it still doesn't appear, contact Eleva Support.
